- `D1-S01` Welcome and opening keynotes (Lino Cattaruzzi, President, Google Iberia)
- `D1-S02` What's new in the world of Search (Gary Illyes, Search Relations)
- `D1-S03` How Search works and where's AI? (Cherry Prommawin, Gary Illyes, Search Relations)
- `D1-S04` Lightning session A: Automation and AI (James Powley, Rafael Kovashikawa, Kira Breuer, Carlos Ortega, Thiago Pojda, other community speakers)

- `D1-S06` How crawling errors affect Search (Cherry Prommawin, Gary Illyes, Search Relations)
- `D1-S07` How Google interprets robots.txt (Google)

- `D1-S10` How Google thinks about crawl budget (Cherry Prommawin, Search Relations)
- `D1-S11` Lightning session C: Crawling (Tobias Schwarz, Jovana Avramovic)
- `D1-S12` Q&A (John Mueller, Gary Illyes, Search Relations)
- `D1-S00` Day 1, session not recorded (n/a)
